title: Ask Richter
subtitle: My Interactive AI CV (Full-Stack RAG Architecture)
summary: Interactive chatbot using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), in-memory FAISS, LangChain.js, Node.js/Express, Supabase, Next.js, Shadcn/ui, and LLMs.
overview: The 'Ask Richter' project transforms a traditional resume into an interactive, intelligent conversational experience. It allows recruiters and tech leaders to explore my career trajectory in natural language with precise answers grounded in a vector knowledge base.
roleDescription: Architect and Full-Stack Developer responsible for the RAG solution design, prompt engineering, vectorization, and frontend/backend implementation.
responsibilities: Built LangChain.js indexing pipeline (DirectoryLoader, RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter) and vectorized content using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small.
Persisted and retrieved FAISS vector index via Supabase Storage.
Developed Node.js, Express, and TypeScript RESTful API with optimized semantic search endpoints.
Reactive Next.js App Router frontend styled with Shadcn/ui and Tailwind CSS, featuring Markdown response rendering with syntax highlighting.
CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions and containerized deployment using Docker on Render.com.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Fast semantic similarity search with minimal cloud infrastructure costs.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Pre-indexed Markdown documents in FAISS stored in Supabase Storage, loading the index into memory on Node.js container startup.

challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Concise and contextually accurate answers without LLM hallucination.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: RAG prompt engineering strictly injecting vector search fragments with temperature controls.

metrics: Semantic similarity search responded in under 150ms
100% professional data coverage in RAG format
